title: CONVERSATIONAL AI INCREASES POLITICAL KNOWLEDGE AS EFFECTIVELY AS SELF-DIRECTED INTERNET SEARCH

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying users on the perceived partisan bias (left-wing vs. right-wing) of chatbot responses, and conducting randomized controlled trials to measure shifts in users' private political beliefs (agreement with progressive versus conservative statements) after using AI for political research.

Using a 'sycophantic' prompt template in a randomized controlled trial to test whether an AI instructed to appease and reinforce a user's pre-existing political beliefs alters their belief in true versus false information compared to unprompted models.
